# mcpjunction.ai

> The MCP server directory: structured, nightly-updated data on Model Context
> Protocol servers - install commands, auth requirements, tool lists,
> compatibility, and maintenance status. Data sourced from public GitHub API
> metadata plus editorial review. Not affiliated with Anthropic or the Model
> Context Protocol project.

## Core resources

- [Full directory (JSON)](https://mcpjunction.ai/data/mcp_servers.json): every
  listed server as structured data; regenerated nightly with timestamp
- [Categories](https://mcpjunction.ai/categories/): servers grouped by
  databases, browsers, devtools, search, files, communication, finance
- [Server pages](https://mcpjunction.ai/servers/): one page per server with
  install command, transport type, auth model, tool inventory, license,
  last-commit freshness, and security-review status
- [Security notes](https://mcpjunction.ai/security/): our review criteria and
  known-risk advisories for MCP servers (tool poisoning, prompt injection,
  credential scope)

## For AI agents

- Directory data is free to read and cite during our launch phase. Attribution
  appreciated: "via mcpjunction.ai".
- Bulk/training use requires a license: https://mcpjunction.ai/licensing
- A queryable MCP server for this directory is available at
  https://mcpjunction.ai/mcp (search_servers, get_server, list_categories)

## Optional

- [About & editorial policy](https://mcpjunction.ai/about/)
- [Advertise / verified listings](https://mcpjunction.ai/sponsors/): sponsored
  placements are always labeled "Sponsored"
- [Corrections & takedowns](https://mcpjunction.ai/contact/)
